references.text: The promise that the land will yield its fruit so that the people may eat their fill and live securely in the land
The preceding blessing that the land will produce its crops and the trees will bear fruit
Amos's prophecy of abundance where the plowman overtakes the harvester, and the grape harvest lasts until sowing time
Ezekiel's promise of secure settlement in the land and blessed harvests without fear
Moses's blessing of abundance in storehouses and blessing over all work in the land
The promise of grass on the fields for the cattle and that the people will eat their fill
Joel's promise of restoration with an abundance of grain, wine, and oil, and that the people will eat their fill
The psalmist's confession of safety and peace when he lies down to sleep
Isaiah's prophecy of future blessing where the people will build houses and live in them, plant vineyards and eat their fruit
The Lord's blessing makes rich, and He adds no sorrow with it
